Common questions
Is backup free or Premium?
Creating .fsback/.fspback backups is part of the Export & Backup toolkit, which requires Premium. Importing files (/import) works on Free, so anyone can restore a backup received from someone else.
Where should I store the backup file?
Anywhere outside Telegram: a cloud drive, your computer, or an encrypted notes app. Telegram keeps the file in your chat too, but Saved Messages is not a backup strategy.
How big is a backup file?
Small — usually kilobytes to a few megabytes, because media is referenced rather than embedded. Text and schedules compress extremely well.
Can I move my schedules to another Telegram account?
Yes. Create a backup on the old account, log into the new one, connect the channel and a sender bot, then restore the backup with Add mode. This is the standard migration path.
